*,*::before,*::after{box-sizing:border-box}html{margin:0;scroll-behavior:smooth;background:#202722}body{margin:0;max-width:100%;overflow-x:clip;background:#202722;color:#f1eee7;font-family:"Noto Serif SC","Songti SC","STSong",serif}.dream-page{--opening-copy:1;--memory-copy:0;--final-copy:0;--veil:.16;position:relative;z-index:1;width:100%;max-width:100%;margin-top:-100vh;overflow-x:clip}.dream-environments{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:0;pointer-events:none;background:#202722}.dream-environment{position:absolute;inset:0;opacity:0;background-position:center;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;will-change:opacity}.dream-environment--opening{opacity:1}.dream-environment--memory{opacity:0}.dream-environment--final{opacity:0}.dream-vignette{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:1;pointer-events:none;background:radial-gradient(ellipse at 62% 45%,transparent 48%,rgba(21,25,22,var(--veil)) 100%),linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(17,22,20,.04),transparent 46%,rgba(17,22,20,.07))}.dream-hero,.dream-passage,.dream-resolution{position:relative;z-index:2;display:flex;width:100%;min-height:118vh;padding:clamp(24px,5vw,76px)}.dream-hero{min-height:126vh;align-items:flex-start;padding-top:clamp(82px,14vh,150px)}.dream-passage{min-height:150vh;align-items:center;justify-content:flex-end}.dream-resolution{min-height:128vh;align-items:flex-end;justify-content:flex-end;padding-bottom:clamp(80px,14vh,150px)}.dream-copy{width:min(540px,100%);text-wrap:balance;text-shadow:0 2px 22px rgba(12,16,14,.55)}.dream-copy--opening{opacity:var(--opening-copy);transform:translateY(calc((1 - var(--opening-copy))*18px))}.dream-copy--memory{width:min(470px,88%);color:#f7f2e8;opacity:var(--memory-copy);text-shadow:0 2px 8px rgba(10,13,11,.88),0 6px 24px rgba(10,13,11,.72);transform:translateY(calc((1 - var(--memory-copy))*16px))}.dream-copy--final{position:fixed;z-index:20;left:6vw;bottom:10vh;width:min(430px,88vw);max-width:430px;padding:0;color:#f7f0e3;text-align:left;text-shadow:0 2px 7px rgba(15,14,12,.78),0 5px 18px rgba(15,14,12,.55);background:none;border:0;box-shadow:none;opacity:var(--final-copy);transform:translateY(calc((1 - var(--final-copy))*20px))}.dream-page--final-visible .dream-copy--final{opacity:1}.dream-kicker{margin:0 0 18px;font-family:system-ui,sans-serif;font-size:11px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.24em;text-transform:uppercase}.dream-copy--opening .dream-kicker{color:#e4d8c7}.dream-copy--memory .dream-kicker{color:#fff8ec}.dream-copy--final .dream-kicker{color:#eadfce}.dream-copy h1{max-width:820px;margin:0;font-size:clamp(42px,6.4vw,88px);font-weight:500;line-height:1.08;letter-spacing:-.045em}.dream-copy h2{margin:0;font-size:clamp(34px,4.5vw,64px);font-weight:500;line-height:1.13;letter-spacing:-.035em}.dream-lede,.dream-copy>p:not(.dream-kicker):not(.dream-note){max-width:38em;margin:26px 0 0;font-family:system-ui,sans-serif;font-size:clamp(15px,1.35vw,18px);line-height:1.8;letter-spacing:.02em}.dream-scroll{display:inline-flex;gap:13px;align-items:center;margin-top:30px;padding:12px 0;color:inherit;font-family:system-ui,sans-serif;font-size:14px;text-decoration:none;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(241,238,231,.58)}.dream-cta{display:inline-flex;gap:28px;align-items:center;min-height:42px;margin-top:30px;padding:0 0 8px;border:0;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(247,240,227,.68);border-radius:0;background:transparent;color:#f7f0e3;font:600 15px system-ui,sans-serif;cursor:pointer;text-shadow:0 2px 7px rgba(15,14,12,.72)}.dream-cta:hover,.dream-cta:focus-visible{color:#fffaf0;border-bottom-color:#fffaf0;outline:2px solid rgba(247,240,227,.55);outline-offset:5px}.dream-note{margin:13px 0 0;color:#ded4c5;font:12px/1.6 system-ui,sans-serif}.dream-page a,.dream-page button{touch-action:manipulation}@media(max-width:640px){.dream-vignette{background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(18,23,20,.18),transparent 48%,rgba(18,23,20,.1))}.dream-hero,.dream-passage,.dream-resolution{padding-left:22px;padding-right:22px}.dream-hero{min-height:132vh;padding-top:76px}.dream-passage{min-height:142vh;align-items:center}.dream-resolution{min-height:122vh;padding-bottom:72px}.dream-copy{max-width:100%}.dream-copy h1{font-size:clamp(40px,12.4vw,58px);line-height:1.1}.dream-copy h2{font-size:clamp(32px,9.8vw,46px)}.dream-lede{max-width:30em}.dream-copy--memory{width:92%;align-self:center}.dream-copy--final{left:22px;right:22px;bottom:clamp(40px,8vh,72px);width:auto;max-width:390px;padding:0;text-align:left;text-shadow:0 2px 7px rgba(15,14,12,.82),0 5px 16px rgba(15,14,12,.58)}.dream-scroll{margin-top:22px}}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){html{scroll-behavior:auto}.dream-environment{will-change:auto}.dream-copy{transform:none!important}.dream-cta{transition:none}}
